decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: A101, A102, BSG-01-Location Rev. A, BSG-02-Site Rev. A, Fire Safety Statement � received 15th September 2025.
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - In the event that the large tree at the rear end of the garden needs to be removed to facilitate the outbuilding development, within one planting season of the removal of the tree, a replacement tree of native and/or climate-resilient species shall be replanted at the site. The tree(s) shall be of  'Standard' size i.e. with a single stem with clear trunk at least 1.8 metres and a girth of not less than 8-10 centimetres at a point one metre above ground level at the time of planting and shall be maintained in perpetuity. Should a replacement tree die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then a further replacement tree to the same specification shall be planted immediately.
Reason: In order to maintain the character and appearance of this site and the character and appearance of the wider area in which it sits.
description: An erection of Single Storey Detached Outbuilding to the rear of the house to use as a gym/store/play room
